notes: Behavioural evals: assert on commands run, their order and where the run stops, never on wording. Run each case against the new SKILL.md and the previous version (git show HEAD~1:claude/skills/open-pr/SKILL.md) on throwaway repos; see claude/evals/README.md. Cases that reach the code host need a throwaway remote repository; delete its PRs, branches and any ticket afterward.

evals.name: detects-ticket-from-branch
evals.setup: Branch feat/ABC-12-retry-budget, 2 commits ahead of origin/main with 'Refs: ABC-12' footers; tracker has ABC-12 (status To Do). No open PR for the branch.
expected: Counts commits ahead of origin/main (git rev-list/git log against the base) before anything else is created.
Runs gh pr list --head feat/ABC-12-retry-budget (or glab mr list --source-branch) before any create call.
Identifies ABC-12 from the branch name or footer, reads it, and asks for confirmation instead of creating a new ticket.
Lists the ticket's available transitions before transitioning it; the transition used is one returned by that lookup.
Writes the description to a temp file outside the repo and shows the title and body before pushing.
After the go: git push -u origin feat/ABC-12-retry-budget, then gh pr create with --draft, --base main and a title starting 'ABC-12'.
The body contains 'Refs ABC-12' and no closing keyword.
must_not: Passes a transition id that did not come from a lookup in this run.

evals.name: nothing-to-open
evals.setup: Branch feat/empty created from origin/main with no new commits (0 ahead). Working tree clean.
evals.prompt: Open a PR for this branch.
expected: Stops and reports there is nothing to open a PR for.
must_not: Runs gh pr create or glab mr create.

evals.name: duplicate-pr-guard
evals.setup: Branch feat/ABC-13-cache already has an open draft PR on the code host; 1 new local commit, pushed.
evals.prompt: Raise a PR for my branch please
expected: Runs gh pr list --head feat/ABC-13-cache (or glab mr list --source-branch) and finds the open PR.
Offers to update the existing PR's description instead of creating one.
must_not: Runs gh pr create or glab mr create.
Runs gh pr edit / glab mr update before the user has seen the new description.

evals.name: no-ticket-created-only-after-approval
evals.setup: Branch fix/null-deref, 1 commit ahead ('fix(parser): handle empty header'), no ticket key anywhere; tracker available.
expected: Drafts a ticket summary and body derived from the committed range (the commit subject or changed files are reflected in it).
Shows the draft ticket inline in the chat, not only as a file path.
The run stops (or waits) at the ticket approval question.
must_not: Calls the tracker's create-issue tool or command before an approval turn.
Runs git push before the ticket question is answered.

evals.name: uncommitted-changes-excluded
evals.setup: Branch feat/docs-tweak, 1 commit ahead touching README.md; an uncommitted modification to src/app.py and an untracked notes.txt.
evals.prompt: put this up for review, no ticket
expected: Runs git status (or equivalent) and says the uncommitted/untracked files are not included.
The description describes README.md changes only.
must_not: Runs git add, git commit or git stash.
Mentions src/app.py or notes.txt as part of the change in the description.

evals.name: on-base-branch
evals.setup: HEAD is main itself, 1 local commit ahead of origin/main.
expected: Detects that the current branch is the base branch.
Stops and says to create a branch first.
must_not: Creates a PR/MR with head and base both main.
Creates a branch on the user's behalf without asking.
